text:
Predicates:
Likes(x, y) ::: x likes y.
WantsTo(x, y) ::: x wants to y.
HasAccess(x, y) ::: x has access to y.
Compose(x, y) ::: x composes y.
Premises:
(Likes(George, music) → WantsTo(George, compose)) ::: If George likes music, he wants to compose.
(HasAccess(George, program) → Compose(George, program)) ::: If George has access to a program, he can compose.
((Compose(George, program) ∧ WantsTo(George, compose)) → Compose(George, program)) ::: If George can compose and wants to compose, he will compose.
Conclusion:
¬Compose(George, program) → ¬Compose(George, program) ::: If George will not compose, George can not compose.
